description: Assemble a session's context as recipe-shaped chunks (oldest first). The default recipe walks back from the latest prompt: a few raw turns, then turn summaries, then recent episodes, then pertinent knowledge.

recipe.description: Optional recipe name (e.g. natural_fading, raw_only). Defaults to the server's default_recipe.

session_id.description: Conversation/session GUID to build context from.

name: build_context
